methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-15 (re-checked 2026-06-18) by fetching each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch: intercom.com/pricing, tidio.com/pricing, gorgias.com/pricing, helpscout.com/pricing. Quote-only vendors confirmed to publish NO prices: forethought.ai/pricing (blend of platform + outcome fees, sales quote), ada.cx/pricing (300K+ annual conversation minimum, consultation only), sierra.ai/pricing (HTTP 404 — no pricing page), decagon.ai/pricing (HTTP 404 — no pricing page), yuma.ai/pricing (demo-only). For all quote-only vendors monthlyUsd=null; any third-party dollar estimates are confined to notes and never placed in numeric fields. Intercom monthly seat prices ($39/$99/$139) and annual ($29/$85/$132) cross-checked via WebSearch after an initial fetch mislabeled annual as monthly. Compliance verified on first-party trust pages: trust.intercom.com / intercom help 7053674, trust.tidio.com, gorgias.com/security, helpscout.com/security + DPA, security.ada.cx, sierra.ai/product/trust-and-reliability, trust.decagon.ai, yuma.ai security blog. Forethought GDPR left null (DPA only, no first-party cert page); Yuma HIPAA left null (not stated). All 10 vendors are real; zero fabricated; zero removed. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Intercom Fin
vendors.provenance: Plan prices fetched from intercom.com/pricing (Essential $39/$29, Advanced $99/$85, Expert $139/$132; monthly figures cross-checked via WebSearch). Compliance from intercom.com/help/.../7053674 + trust.intercom.com listing SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA, HDS.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Monthly billing $39/seat; annual billing $29/seat (~26% off). Includes Fin AI Agent access at $0.99 per resolved outcome (charged separately on top of seat price). Messenger, shared inbox, ticketing, public help center, pre-built reports.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Monthly billing $99/seat; annual billing $85/seat (~14% off). Adds multiple team inboxes, workflow automation, round-robin assignment, multilingual help center, 20 free Lite seats. Fin AI Agent $0.99/outcome extra.

plans.name: Expert
plans.notes: Monthly billing $139/seat; annual billing $132/seat (~5% off). Adds SSO & identity management, HIPAA support, SLAs, multibrand, 50 free Lite seats. Fin AI Agent $0.99/outcome extra.

plans.name: Fin Standalone
plans.notes: From $0.99 per resolved Fin outcome, no seat required. Works on top of existing helpdesks (e.g. Salesforce). An outcome counts when the customer confirms resolution, doesn't ask for more help, or Fin completes a workflow. Usage-based; minimum commitment may apply.

limits: Fin AI Agent billed from $0.99/outcome on top of seat fees
WhatsApp, SMS, phone and outbound carry additional usage fees
Minimum 1 full seat required for core plans
keyFeatures: Fin AI Agent resolves issues autonomously across chat, email, and voice
Per-outcome pricing — only pay when Fin fully resolves a conversation

ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI governance certification

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: ~$59/mo monthly; from ~$49.17/mo annually. Scales from 250 up to 2,000 billable conversations/month. Advanced analytics, auto chat assignment, macros, permissions, ticketing automations. Lyro AI add-on from $32.50/mo for 50 conversations.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Starts at $749/mo. Custom billable conversations, departments, multiproject, custom branding, OpenAPI access, dedicated Success Manager, live chat support.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Contact for pricing. Includes 3,000+ Lyro AI conversations/month, guaranteed 50% Lyro AI resolution rate, Mobile SDK, advanced Copilot, managed service, Slack support, SSO, compliance features.

limits: Free plan capped at 50 conversations/month

Growth scales 250 to 2,000 conversations; higher volume requires Plus/Premium
